TextUsedForAnnotation: Request Number - 587 | Request Title - Support an 'invite friends' feature. | Request Description - How about having a handy link (and easily found) to allow users to share your app?
comment: The feature request doesn't describe the expected actions that would result from clicking the link or how a user should access the link.
question: Where in the user interface should a user obtain this link?
What actions should occur when a new user follows the link? (e.g. be taken to the app store page, automatically add the link provider as a friend, etc.)
interpretation: What should the link itself do or point to? Simply the app's store page? Should it automatically associate the new user as a friend of the link provider?; Where in the user interface should this link be found?
affectDescription: Incomplete information might carry expectations of follow-on tasks associated with clicking the provided link.
missing_information: "Specify the method for inviting friends (e.g., via email, SMS, social media)", "Clarify if the feature should include tracking or analytics of invites sent", "Determine if the feature should integrate with existing contact lists or allow manual entry", "Explain the expected user flow for inviting friends", "Identify any user permissions required to access contacts or send invites", "Specify any design or placement requirements for the link in the app", "Indicate potential platforms (iOS, Android, etc.) and any platform-specific considerations"
